scope: Correction: real movie posters and CC film frames replace inline geometric illustrations. Unconfirmed images are omitted by the owner’s explicit choice.
conditions: Apple artwork is conditional promotional material, not a general stock-image license. Each poster links to the corresponding returned US purchase page and has the approved iTunes badge in the same figure. No cover, social image or fallback gallery use; no affiliate tag. Remove if permission or store availability changes.
limitations: Provenance and conditions documented; no guarantee against claims or guarantee of advertising-platform approval. No licensed image may be reused outside its documented context.
